id.description: Stable unique id, e.g. cs-async-0007. Never change once published.

language.description: write-code only: the language the user writes in.

starter.description: write-code only: what the editor starts with, usually the method signature with an empty body.

helpers.description: write-code (C#) only: types/methods available to both the user's code and the tests (e.g. ListNode and FromArray/ToArray). Shown read-only.

tests.description: write-code (C#) only: each test calls the user's code. Values compare by their printed form, so collections compare by content.

call.description: C# expression evaluated inside the Solution class, e.g. TwoSum(new[] { 2, 7 }, 9). Or statements ending in return.

expect.description: C# expression for the expected value, e.g. new[] { 0, 1 }.

unordered.description: The result is a collection whose order doesn't matter.

code.description: predict-output: C# top-level statements. predict-result: the SQL query (SQLite dialect). Required for both.

setup.description: predict-result and SQL write-code: SQL (SQLite) that creates and fills the tables, shown to the user as grids.

expect.description: predict-result only: the result rows (default; one per line, values comma-separated), the number of rows, or how a table is read according to the query plan (Full table scan, Full index scan, Covering index scan, Index seek, Covering index seek, Primary key seek).

planTable.description: table-access only: the table the question is about, as named in the plan (its alias if aliased). Needed when the query reads several tables.

answer.description: The correct answer. write-code: the reference solution (C# code, or the SQL query whose result the user must match).

accepted.description: Other typed answers accepted as correct in recall mode.

recall.description: How typed answers are graded. Defaults: exact for concept/predict-output, self for pick-the-code.
